subject: Exclusive Offer Inside: Limited Time Only!
body: Dear valued customer, We are excited to announce our exclusive offer just for you! For a limited time only, you can enjoy 30% off on all our products. Don't miss out on this amazing opportunity to upgrade your wardrobe or home decor. Visit our website or stop by our store today to take advantage of this special deal. Hurry, the offer ends soon! Best regards, The Marketing Team
